name: Curvilinear to Rectilinear Resampling
definition: A family of methods to convert a curvilinear input grid (hexahedral cells with 8 vertices) into a rectilinear output grid by estimating function values at new sample points.
summary: Curvilinear to Rectilinear Resampling converts distorted curvilinear grids to standard rectilinear ones by localizing cells and interpolating values, explicitly handling geometric distortion unlike sibling methods.
